title: Kyle Monangai helped the Bears make NFL history and earned his spot as a Week 1 Secret Superstar

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Kyle Monangai helped the Bears make NFL history and earned his spot as a Week 1 Secret Superstar
sources.description: Chicago's record 59-37 rout wasn't the only surprise: a 49ers trade addition finally gave San Francisco's pass rush life, and a Commanders special teamer delivered one of the most viral hits of the young season.
